title: Bond and Estate Supervision
text: {% if will.bond == "required" %}Each Personal Representative serving hereunder shall furnish bond with surety as required by law or court order.{% else %}No bond shall be required of any Personal Representative serving hereunder, whether or not specifically named in this Last Will and Testament, or if a bond is required by law, then no surety will be required on such bond.{% endif %} {% if will.supervision == "supervised" %}I request supervised administration of my estate.{% else %}I request that the administration of my estate be unsupervised.{% endif %}
